# Layouts360

> The Operating System for Modern Real Estate Developers in India. Focus on closing deals, not juggling spreadsheets.

## Project Summary
Layouts360 replaces outdated PDFs, Excel sheets, and static maps with an all-in-one Real Estate ERP and Digital Layout system. It enables developers to showcase plots on live satellite imagery, manage inventory in real-time, and streamline bookings and payments.

## Core Features
- **Interactive Digital Layouts**: Convert static CAD/PDF maps into zoomable, satellite-overlaid interactive experiences.
- **Real-Time Inventory Management**: Centralized "Single Source of Truth" database. Instantly marks plots as Available, Booked, or Sold across all devices.
- **Lead & Sales CRM**: Built-in CRM to capture leads, track follow-ups, and manage customer lifecycles.
- **Mobile-First Design**: Optimized for field agents to showcase layouts and close deals on-site using tablets or phones.
- **Financial Tracking**: Manages booking payments, partial payments, and generates payment schedules.

## Pricing Model
- **Sales Starter**: ₹2,000/month
  - Digital Layouts, Plot Management, Unlimited Users.
- **Growth Suite**: ₹4,000/month
  - Adds CRM, Lead Management, Booking Tracking, Payment Records.
- **Digitization Fee**: One-time setup fee starting at ₹10,000 (includes 150 plots).
